blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Noel Kampton nearly cost the game after his premature celebration, but Criss Cross recovered in time to beat Savouge, 22-25, 18-25, 25-16, 25-22, 16-14, and stay unbeaten in two games in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday night at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. The moment after hitting what was supposed to be a game-winning spike for Criss Cross, Kampton crossed the net and celebrated with the crowd–a motion that Savouge challenged as a centerline fault to force a deuce at 14-all.
